transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my family brought me in. It was... we were down at the fair, and I was giving a talk. But I ended up climbing up onto a tractor. I just kept jerking the controls around to show the crowd this new pattern I'd figured out. People started yelling at me to stop and get down, but... I just couldn't make myself stop doing it. So, they brought me here.
Did you feel unusually energetic or excited when you were climbing up onto the tractor and jerking the controls around?

Yeah, I did. I've just had so much energy lately. It's like... well, I'll get up and go from fixing fence to recalibrating the sprayer, and then I'm calling suppliers, all before breakfast. And by noon, I've started five more jobs than any crew could finish. I just have to keep moving and getting things done. So when I was up on that tractor, I was just really fired up.
Have you been feeling unusually happy or euphoric lately?

Well, yeah, I suppose I have. Some mornings I wake up and it feels like... like the whole valley is just opening up for me. I'll be out there grinning at absolutely nothing. 

But it turns real quick, too. If one of the hired hands questions what I'm doing, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down... I just snap at them. I get so mad, like they've insulted the family name or something. So I guess I feel real good sometimes, but I get set off pretty easy, too.
Have you had any periods where you felt really down or depressed recently?
No, not really. I haven't been feeling down or depressed at all. Like I said, I've just been going and going. I haven't had any time to feel sad.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear?

Well, yeah, I have. Out by the north pasture... especially right around dusk, I hear these voices. Clear as day. They sound like they're coming right out of the irrigation lines. They, uh, they tell me exactly which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. And the thing is, it's not just when I've got all that energy going. It still happens on the weeks when I'm not all fired up, too.
How long have you been feeling this way, with all this energy and these ups and downs?

Well, it's been going on for a while now. I'd say about... a year and two months. Yeah, right around the time we refinanced the place and started that big farm readjustment. That's when all this really started up.
Do you have times when you feel normal, with a regular amount of energy, or is it always one extreme or the other?

Yeah, I do have normal times. Actually, there were several quieter weeks not too long ago where I wasn't especially energized or feeling grand, just... regular. I was just going about my normal work. 

But the thing is, even when my energy settled down like that, I still heard the lines talking to me. And I still knew that the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. So the energy goes back to a normal level, but all that other stuff just keeps right on going.
Do the voices in the irrigation lines or the warnings from the farm data ever stop, even when you're feeling normal?

No, they don't stop. Like I was just saying, there were a few weeks recently where things were pretty quiet for me. I wasn't all fired up or feeling ten feet tall, just had my regular energy. But even during those quiet weeks, I still heard the voices coming from the irrigation lines. And I still knew, without a doubt, that the farm data had those hidden warnings in it. So the energy leveled out, but the voices and the warnings stayed right there.
Do you hear the voices or receive warnings from the farm data only when you're feeling energetic or upset, or do you hear them even when you're feeling calm and normal?

Well, like I just said... yeah, I hear them even when I'm calm. It doesn't seem to matter if my energy is all fired up or if I'm just feeling regular. 

During those quiet weeks I just told you about, I was feeling completely normal. But the voices in the lines and the warnings in the data were still there. They don't just go away when my energy settles down.
Do these periods of high energy and feeling really good or really bad happen at regular intervals, or is it more random?

Well, I wouldn't call it regular intervals, no. It's not like clockwork. Actually, for most of this whole stretch... I've just been running on that charged, driven feeling. It's been taking up the majority of the time lately. I've been making all these big plans, just going non-stop, and... well, snapping at anyone who tries to slow me down. So it's not really random or on a schedule, it's just that I've been stuck in that high gear for most of it.
How long have you been hearing voices in the irrigation lines?
Well, the voices and those coded warnings... they've been going on for about 11 months now. It's been nearly a year of dealing with it.
Do you only hear the voices in the irrigation lines when you're feeling really energetic or upset, or do you hear them at other times as well?

I think we just talked about that, Doctor. I hear them even when I'm feeling calm and regular, not just when I'm all fired up. Like I said, during those quiet weeks, my energy was completely normal, but the voices in the lines were still there. They don't stop just because my mood settles down.
Have you ever heard the voices in the irrigation lines when you were feeling really down or depressed?

No, I... I don't think so. I haven't really been feeling down or depressed. Like I mentioned, it's mostly just been that high gear, or just regular days working the farm. I haven't really had any low spells to speak of. So, no, I haven't heard them during a time like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt really down or depressed and also heard the voices in the irrigation lines at the same time?

I think you might have just asked me that, doc. Like I said a second ago... no. I haven't had any periods where I felt down or depressed at all. It's just been those high-gear times or regular days working the farm. So I haven't heard them while feeling low, because I just haven't been feeling low.
When you're feeling really energetic and driven, does it always start and stop abruptly, or is it more of a gradual change?

It's... well, it's pretty sudden, usually. One day I'm just going about my business, getting the chores done, and then... bam. It's like someone flipped a switch on a tractor. I just wake up and I'm running on all cylinders, ready to take on the whole farm before noon. And when it stops, it's kind of the same way. The engine just cuts out, and I'm back to my regular speed. It doesn't really build up slow or fade out, it just happens.
When you're feeling really energetic and driven, do you always feel extremely happy or like you're on top of the world at the same time?

Well, it's a mix, I guess. Some mornings during those high-gear times, yeah, I feel like the whole valley is just opening up for me. I'll be out there on the tractor grinning at absolutely nothing. 

But... it's not always just happy. If one of the hired hands questions how I'm doing things, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down, I get real short. I'll snap at 'em like they just insulted the family name. So, I feel real good, but I also get pretty fired up if anyone tries to get in my way or slow me down.
After one of these high-energy periods, do you usually feel tired, empty, or depressed afterwards?

No, I can't say that I do. Like I mentioned a few minutes ago, I don't really get those down or depressed feelings. 

When that high energy stops, I just... well, I just go back to my normal speed. I mean, my body might be a regular kind of tired if I've been running a tractor for fourteen hours straight, but mentally? No, I don't feel empty or low. I just go back to feeling like my regular self, doing my regular chores.
How long has the longest period of feeling really energetic and driven lasted for you?

Well, if I look back over the past year or so... it's been most of it. I'd say those charged-up, nonstop stretches where I hardly need any sleep have taken up about ten months out of the last twelve. It just keeps going.
Have you ever had a period where you felt really down or depressed, and if so, how long did it last?

No, I really haven't. Like I said before, I don't get those down spells. I don't feel sad or empty or anything like that. I just have my normal days, and then those long stretches where I'm fired up and running on all cylinders. But no, no periods of feeling depressed at all.
How many days in a row have you typically felt this extremely energetic and driven during one of these high-gear times?

Well, I don't exactly count the days. Like I was saying a minute ago, it just... it stretches on for months at a time. I couldn't give you a specific number of days in a row. It just feels like one long, continuous run where I'm up and working the farm, day after day, until it finally stops. I just lose track of the exact count.
